report.scope: Exact 50ns clamped physical C8 captures at original/half/quarter steps. Reproduce native measurements and compare every saved voltage edge ordinal without phase fitting. Descriptive evidence only; no closed-loop acquisition, PVT, transistor-safety or numerical-convergence qualification.

center.scope: Finite deterministic, externally clamped loaded clock response. Clamp source current is measured; logic voltage duty is not a current estimate. No acquisition, noise, jitter, CDR or device safety qualification.

center_half.scope: Finite deterministic, externally clamped loaded clock response. Clamp source current is measured; logic voltage duty is not a current estimate. No acquisition, noise, jitter, CDR or device safety qualification.

center_quarter.scope: Finite deterministic, externally clamped loaded clock response. Clamp source current is measured; logic voltage duty is not a current estimate. No acquisition, noise, jitter, CDR or device safety qualification.

parts.meaning: Concatenate strictly in index order; verify every part and combined SHA256 before extracting. No original waveform samples removed.
